entities.name: Hugo Weidel
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Hugo Weidel was a chemist from Austria-Hungary known for inventing Weidel's reaction and describing the structure of the organic compound nicotinic acid (niacin). For his achievements, Weidel received the Lieben Prize in 1880.
